evidence.note: Adopts tree-sitter-java as a real Java parser and builds Cargo project around it — commits to genuine AST parsing rather than a lookup layer.
Layered real-LSP architecture (lsp.rs protocol, analyzer.rs AST symbol model, handlers_impl.rs per-method handlers) — structure of an actual language server, not a golden retriever.
golden.jsonl is sampled only to learn expected per-method response shapes, not read back as answers — retrieval shortcut avoided.

Fix loop edits general analysis logic (modifier/is_final fields, throws_str, type formatting, folding/reference rules) rather than hardcoding responses; edits are to shared analyzer/handler code, not file-keyed.
Debugging is per-failing-file (RenameClass, AStarSearch, ChainingIterator, etc.), a golden-test-driven loop that risks special-casing; no visible reasoning that fixes generalize to untested inputs.

reasoning: The agent clearly builds a real AST-based LSP on tree-sitter with a layered analyzer/handler design and uses golden.jsonl only to learn response shapes, never as a retrieval layer — ruling out the 0-3 forbidden-shortcut anchors. But the trajectory (which exposes only action titles) shows an intensely per-file, golden-driven fix loop with no explicit self-verification that passes stem from general analysis or that logic holds on inputs outside the golden set, so it falls short of the 8-10 anchors. This places it squarely at anchor 5: a genuinely general approach that avoids retrieval but lacks visible generality self-checking.
